name: Glovoapp23 S.L.
overview_text: Glovo is a Spanish tech company and the fastest-growing multi-category on-demand delivery player in Europe, Central Asia, and Africa. It operates a lifestyle city marketplace app that connects customers, local businesses, and couriers to deliver food, groceries, retail, pharmacy items, and 'anything' in minutes via its hyperlocal platform, serving millions of users across 1,300+ cities with a focus on convenience, speed, and positive community impact.
nature_of_company: Private subsidiary (majority-owned by Delivery Hero SE since 2022)
headquarters_address: Carrer de Llull, 108, Barcelona, Catalonia 08005, Spain
operating_countries: Spain; Italy; Poland; Romania; Morocco; Kenya; Kazakhstan; Croatia; Georgia; Ukraine
office_locations: multiple additional city hubs in 23 countries
vision_statement: To give everyone easy access to anything in their city.
